## Substantial differences

- **New mandatory pre-heating step in Version B:** Version B adds: “**Pre-heat all epoxy resin drums in hot box HB-1, 40 °C, 12 h**.” This introduces a processing condition and an additional equipment/time requirement that is absent from Version A.
- **Revision and effective date changed:**  
  - Version A: “**Rev 1, effective 10/04/1997**”  
  - Version B: “**Rev 2, effective 08/02/1999**”
- **Batch size information is omitted in Version B:** Version A states “**Batch 800 kg**”; Version B does not. This removes an explicit production-quantity reference, although no new batch size is specified.
- **Change-control reference added:** Version B identifies the change as “**CR-1999-002**,” linking the pre-heating requirement to a formal change record.

All ingredient quantities, mixing times, acceptance criterion, filling format, equipment, and labeling instructions otherwise remain unchanged.

## Additions in B

- “**Pre-heat all epoxy resin drums in hot box HB-1, 40 °C, 12 h.**”
- “**Added hot box pre-heating of resin drums (CR-1999-002).**”
- Updated revision and effective date: “**Rev 2, effective 08/02/1999.**”

## Removals compared with A

- The explicit statement “**Batch 800 kg**” is not present in Version B.
- No process step or formulation ingredient from Version A is otherwise removed; the original steps are retained and renumbered because of the added pre-heating step.

## Rewordings

- “**Ref. EF-210 Rev 1 10 April 1997**” becomes “**Ref. EF-210 Rev 2 8 February 1999**.”
- The original step numbering shifts from Steps 1–7 to Steps 1–8.
- The change note is reformulated from “**New product EF-210, Part A. Batch 800 kg.**” to “**Added hot box pre-heating of resin drums (CR-1999-002).**”
- The recipe, quantities, operating parameters, and quality criterion are otherwise substantively equivalent.
